title: W12 canonical native-image closure proof review

binding.boundary: Supplied ordinary Lean compile and raw axiom reports only. No official gate, leanchecker, hardware or new namespace acceptance is inherited.

unconditional_native_closure.domain: All native a b:Float32, not all original raw payloads. Valid native packed NaN is the unique logical nan; ofFloat32 nan has exact raw0x7fc00000 and native images are non-signaling.
unconditional_native_closure.nonNaN_inputs: The real base R7Native.ofFloat32Add/Mul require input isNaN=false only; they allow Inf and invalid NaN outputs.
unconditional_native_closure.NaN_input_cases: Left NaN selects canonical left because right imported image cannot be signaling. With nonNaN left and right NaN, actual selector chooses canonical right. Both NaNs fall under left case. Native propagation plus actual carrier/model projections close full-carrier equality.
unconditional_native_closure.not_arbitrary_raw: ofFloat32(toFloat32 q) canonicalizes a noncanonical raw NaN. The unrestricted operation theorem starts with ofFloat32 a/ofFloat32 b and does not establish arbitrary raw roundtrip.

mapping.selected: W05 two classifiers, native_eq_nan_of_isNaN, native NaN add/mul bridges; only W12 first namespace through add_ofFloat32/mul_ofFloat32. No complete W05/W01/W02/fold package.

seed_boundaries.public_seed: +0 is in the image, including n=0. Operand hypotheses concern actual accessed words; nonNaN includes Inf, subnormal and signed zero. Canonical raw NaN is also an image member, so nonNaN scan is sufficient but stronger.
